subjects.role: plain Bash and Readline control; no independent live history panel

pairing_preflight: for each keymap, first pass both standalone control traces; then attempt the paired trace; only a demonstrated paired behavior mismatch may leave the pairing unqualified, and preparation, identity, timeout or harness errors reject the corpus

framework_editor_track.loader_config: genuine pinned loaders with the same portable startup plugin fixture; themes and update checks disabled in this matched-feature track
framework_editor_track.selected_editor_features: Binit completion and live history with syntax highlighting disabled; ble.sh history-driven suggestions and completion, with syntax, filename and variable highlighting and syntax-driven auto-completion disabled
framework_editor_track.limits: The Binit plus ble pairing checks an explicitly created alpha_pair_probe file, the enabled provider registration and live ble Tab binding; only observed completion of that file without a provider start is classified as an isolated-provider mismatch. Configured feature targets share inputs and checked effects but retain different menus, history windows, completion semantics and isolated-provider capabilities; they do not establish full feature parity.
framework_editor_track.qualification: each framework-plus-editor pairing enters measurement only after its framework-only and editor-only controls and the paired trace pass in both keymaps; observed mismatches stay unequal, infrastructure failures reject the corpus

environment.shell: the same selected stock Bash and matching Readline for every subject
environment.terminal: PTY 32x120 except the explicit 32x40 wrap trace, bracketed paste enabled, 8 MiB output bound and 10 second phase timeout
environment.history: synthetic private history; HISTSIZE and HISTFILESIZE 4096, no personal data
environment.provider: same ordinary Bash function for stateful cases; Binit's public isolated provider registration and a separately declared ble.sh-compatible isolated wrapper
environment.initialization: prepared Binit generation and ble.sh build outside measured input intervals; verify public editor identity and active configuration
environment.privacy: input and histories are synthetic; no user startup files or shell installation
environment.typing_tail: per-event monotonic timing to terminal response; retain all samples, no p99 unless at least 1000 acknowledged input events
environment.identity: driver, terminal observer, contract, input histories, provider, Bash, selected Binit binary and module, ble.sh sources and build outputs checked before and after each run
environment.resources: observe owned shell/descendants and descriptors separately; approximate non-atomic RSS, explicit vanished samples; no peak claim
environment.failure: retain failed traces and raw terminal output; a failure cannot be converted into a missing or unsupported timing row

comparability: Plain Readline is a control without Binit's or ble.sh's editor features.

Binit's live panel uses the newest 1000 entries. Explicit Ctrl-R searches across in-memory history on current development builds. The 0.1.0 and 0.1.1 releases require the recent-only comparison profile.
Frameworks without editors require an explicitly checked editor pairing; untested pairings remain unqualified.
Binit plus ble.sh must pass compatibility behavior before any pairing can be measured.
Isolated and current-shell stateful providers have different effects and are not interchangeable.

measurement.order: alternate subject order by run and pair
measurement.results: raw events, effects and per-run distributions; no pooled overall winner
